items.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Nationals 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwMDA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--97a368da9c2de5730f34fd117f5c205ff16be083/SaintVincentandtheGrenadinesNationals2027_logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbXFIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21ca44b60799bf464134d7d44eddd25b4260efdf/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png) The first WCA competition in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines! 🇻🇨 Cubers of all ages and skill levels are encouraged to sign up. This competition serves as the **2027 National Championship for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate; however, only competitors who are nationals of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines are eligible to receive prizes.
